subject: BrightCart - marketplace private offer unit price qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Castillo <elena@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sara Connelly <sara.connelly@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: BrightCart - marketplace private offer unit price qualification

Hi Elena / BrightCart team —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can scope the AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace private offers and map to unit pricing: 

Summary from call:
- Target workloads: document search + real-time personalization for checkout flows.
- Estimated token volumes: 180M–220M tokens / month initially (spiking to ~300M in Q1 post-launch).
- Current target unit economics: target $/1M tokens in the range of $900–$1,000 (BrightCart finance suggested a target blended unit cost around $950/1M tokens).
- Target monthly budget: $160k–$220k depending on launch timing and caching adjustments.

What we need to confirm to move forward with marketplace private offers: 
1) Can you confirm the 180M–220M tokens/mo baseline and whether procurement needs a formal committed spend figure for a private offer?
2) Which marketplace(s) do you want pricing pushed to first (AWS recommended; also confirm if GCP/Azure marketplace is required in parallel)?
3) Any internal PO cadence or procurement window we need to meet (e.g., approval by 10/15)?

Next steps from our side:
- I attached a pricing spreadsheet (brightcart_pricing_v1.xlsx) that maps Redwood unit prices to Marketplace SKU-level list prices and demonstrates an example private-offer discount to hit your $950 target.
- Aditya will run the unit-price mapping across our AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace flows and confirm how committed offer construction works with AWS Marketplace.
- Sara (AWS) — can you confirm the private-offer workflow and any constraints we should know about for per-1M-token SKUs?

Thanks — if you can confirm the volume/budget numbers and preferred marketplace, we’ll prepare a formal private offer proposal to share with procurement.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Castillo <elena@brightcart.com>

Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2026-09-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart - marketplace private offer unit price qualification

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side: 

- Baseline confirmed: 180M–220M tokens / month for initial phase. We expect a lift to ~300M in Q1.
- Budget: procurement is targeting a committed monthly spend between $160k–$220k to meet our fiscal forecasting.
- Target unit price: finance is aiming for $900–$1,000 / 1M tokens (prefers to land closer to $950/1M).

Procurement note: they prefer to see a committed spend/term (e.g., 12-month private offer) to approve the Marketplace private offer. Please include an example committed spend tier that maps to the target blended unit price.

Marketplace preference: AWS first (we are active there today). We’ll want GCP later this quarter but it can be staggered.

Can you also provide: 
- A short mapping table that shows list price vs. private-offer price across AWS SKUs (per-1M-token SKU) so procurement can see the discount math.
- Any compliance or billing info AWS Marketplace requires for private offers (we’ll share vendor onboarding contacts once you send the template).

Thanks — Elena
VP, Engineering Operations | BrightCart
elena@brightcart.com

From: Sara Connelly <sara.connelly@amazon.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Castillo <elena@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightCart - marketplace private offer unit price qualification

Hi Marissa / Elena —

Thanks for the thread. Quick notes from AWS Marketplace side: 

- Private Offer workflow: AWS supports custom pricing on marketplace SKUs via Private Offers. You can create a per-1M-token consumable SKU (we see that pattern commonly) and then issue a private offer with a discounted price.
- Required artifacts: pricing sheet, signed private-offer template (I attached a blank template — aws_private_offer_template.pdf), and a contact for procurement to receive the vendor onboarding docs.
- Example mapping (illustrative):
  • SKU: REDWOOD-1M-TOKENS-US (list price): $1,200 / 1M tokens
  • Private Offer example (to hit $950 target): offer price $950 / 1M tokens = ~20.8% discount off list
  • If BrightCart commits to 12 months at 200M tokens/mo, total annual committed spend = 200M * 12 * ($950 / 1M) = $2,280,000 (used to calculate seller discount tiers).
- Constraints: Marketplace billing granularity is per-SKU usage; we recommend Redwood expose a single per-1M-token SKU to match procurement expectations. For overage handling, you can either bill at private-offer price for all usage or set an overage SKU at list price.

Happy to engage the Marketplace seller support team once you share the final pricing spreadsheet.

Best,
Sara Connelly
AWS Marketplace — Partner Development
Sara.Connelly@amazon.com

Attachment: aws_private_offer_template.pdf

Elena / team —

Thanks — this is great. Action items and next steps: 

1) Marissa/Redwood (today by 9/23): Aditya will produce the SKU-level mapping that shows list price vs. private-offer price across AWS, plus a mirrored table for GCP/Azure for reference. Will include a committed-spend tier table to hit the $950 blended target.
2) BrightCart procurement (by 10/06): confirm committed term preference (12 vs 24 months) and the committed monthly tokens baseline to lock in the private-offer tier.
3) AWS (Sara): once we share the final pricing spreadsheet, please open the private-offer case with Seller Support and confirm the DocuSign flow for signatures.
4) Redwood finance (cc Rafael): we’ll need a seller-side discount tier proposal to model margins at the $950/1M target. Rafael — can you draft seller discount tiers based on the 200M/mo committed baseline?

I’ve attached an updated spreadsheet (brightcart_pricing_v1.xlsx) with a first-pass mapping and an example 12-month committed tier that hits $950/1M if BrightCart commits to 200M tokens/mo.

I’ll follow up with a focused pricing file and schedule a 30-min procurement alignment call for next week.

Cheers,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
